Seven serialized TMP font assets

WindWings 1.3.118 · provisional static reference · report 73.

Not a game-font rendering preview. These are original v2 SDF atlas PNGs plus serialized metadata. No Unity shader, glyph placement, kerning, rich text, RTL or shaping is executed. Browser typography is not the APK font.

Copy this HTML file to the root of extracted assets-v2.zip, beside its Texture2D/ directory, then open offline. The Git copy has no original media and cannot show PNGs by itself. The one v2 TTF is a separate exported font program; do not invent a source-font pointer for the seven static TMP assets.

Settings default: #105. Asset-local ordered fallback chain: 105 → 110 → 106 → 108 → 109 → 111 → 107. Global settings contain one null fallback entry, not an empty local chain. All seven recovered assets use static population mode 0; all source-font pointers are null.
